organize.title: Organize “{{name}}”?
organize.intro: Spiral will move these files to match the path format. Nothing moves until you confirm.
organize.nothingToMove: Every file is already where the path format puts it. Spiral will keep new files organized too.

conflicts.targetExists: A file already exists at {{path}}, so this one gets a numbered name.
conflicts.duplicateTarget: Another track also goes to {{path}}, so this one gets a numbered name.
conflicts.sourceMissing: The file is missing, so it stays where it is.
conflicts.sourceUnreadable: Spiral can't read the file ({{error}}), so it stays where it is.
conflicts.insideSpiralFolder: Its new path is in a part of the folder Spiral doesn't scan, so it stays where it is.
conflicts.hiddenTarget: Its new path has a hidden name (starting with a dot), so it stays where it is.
conflicts.invalidTarget: The path format gives an invalid path ({{error}}), so it stays where it is.

organize.moved_one: Moved {{count}} file. Spiral now keeps this source organized.
organize.moved_other: Moved {{count}} files. Spiral now keeps this source organized.
organize.failedCount_one: {{count}} file couldn't be moved and stays where it was.
organize.failedCount_other: {{count}} files couldn't be moved and stay where they were.
